timeline.e: Founded on 15 March after a dispute over Anfield rent with Everton.
Bill Shankly arrives and rebuilds the club.
First European Cup, in Rome, in the first of a run of four in eight years (1977, 78, 81, 84).
Heysel Stadium disaster; 39 people died before the European Cup final.
Hillsborough disaster on 15 April; 97 fans died. The Justice for the 96/97 campaign ran for decades.
18th league title, the last of the old era.
The Miracle of Istanbul: from 3-0 down to win the Champions League on penalties.
19th league title, the first in 30 years.
FA Cup and League Cup double.
20th league title under Arne Slot, equalling Manchester United's record.
Summer reset: Salah, Robertson and Konaté leave; Barcola, Jacquet and Muñoz arrive (as reported).

facts: Anfield's Anfield Road stand expansion took capacity above 61,000.
'You'll Never Walk Alone' was adopted by the Kop in the 1960s.
The Shankly Gates were unveiled in 1982.
